```{r setup}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "~/Alyssa/Single_Cell_CHIP_Vascular/")
library(tidyverse)
library(bsseq)
```

# https://www.bioconductor.org/packages/devel/bioc/vignettes/bsseq/inst/doc/bsseq_analysis.html

```{r}
bsseq_chive = readRDS("../DNA_Methylation/output_data/bsseq_chive.rds")
```

```{r}
chive_data = read_csv("../DNA_Methylation/tables/chive_all_data.csv")
chive_cell_proportions = read_tsv("../DNA_Methylation/tables/df_combined.tsv")

chive_all = inner_join(chive_data, chive_cell_proportions, by = c(Patient_ID = "Patient ID", Sample_ID = "Sample ID")) %>%
  filter(is.na(`Mutation-2`)) %>%
  filter(`Mutation-1` %in% c("TET2", "DNMT3A", NA)) %>%
  dplyr::select("VANTAGE ID", "Mutation-1") %>%
  dplyr::rename(CHIP = "Mutation-1")

chive_all$CHIP[is.na(chive_all$CHIP)] = "Control"
chive_all$bsseq_names = paste0("input_data/", chive_all$`VANTAGE ID`, ".CX_report.txt.gz")

tet2_bsseq_names = chive_all %>%
  filter(CHIP == "TET2") %>%
  pull(bsseq_names)
dnmt3a_bsseq_names = chive_all %>%
  filter(CHIP == "DNMT3A") %>%
  pull(bsseq_names)
control_bsseq_names = chive_all %>%
  filter(CHIP == "Control") %>%
  pull(bsseq_names)
```


```{r}
smoothed_chive = BSmooth(bsseq_chive)
smoothed_chive = updateObject(smoothed_chive)
coverage = getCoverage(smoothed_chive)
loci_to_keep = which(rowSums(coverage[,c(1:45)]) >= 2 & rowSums(coverage[,c(46:91)]) >= 2)
length(loci_to_keep)

chr_info = smoothed_chive@rowRanges@seqnames
data.frame(chr_info@values,chr_info@lengths)

loci_to_keep = which(rowSums(coverage[,c(1:45)] >= 2) >= 2 & rowSums(coverage[,c(46:91)] >= 2) >= 2)
smoothed_chive_subset = smoothed_chive[loci_to_keep,]

table(seqnames(smoothed_chive_subset))
#chromosomes_to_keep = setdiff(seqlevels(smoothed_chive_subset), c("chr14", "chr21", "chr4", "chr12", "chr15", "chr18", "chr20", "chrX", "chrY"))

chromosomes_to_keep = c("chr17", "chr19", "chr16", "chr7", "chr1", "chr6", "chr9", "chr11")
smoothed_chive_subset = keepSeqlevels(smoothed_chive_subset, chromosomes_to_keep, pruning.mode = "coarse")


chive_stats = BSmooth.tstat(smoothed_chive_subset, 
                            group1 = dnmt3a_bsseq_names,
                            group2 = control_bsseq_names, 
                            estimate.var = "same",
                            local.correct = TRUE,
                            verbose = TRUE)


plot(chive_stats)
```
```{r}
(dmrs0 = dmrFinder(chive_stats, cutoff = c(-0.5, 0.5)))

```

```{r}
(dmrs = subset(dmrs0, n >= 3 & abs(meanDiff) >= 0.1))
```
